nombre_oficial.texto: Zócalo, Metropolitan Cathedral and National Palace

frase_gancho.texto: The largest square in the city and the buildings where much of the country’s history was decided.

introduccion_narrativa.texto: You have arrived at the Zócalo, the great square of Mexico. Around it stand the Metropolitan Cathedral and the Sagrario, the National Palace, the old City Hall building, the merchants’ arcades, the Gran Hotel Ciudad de México, and the Nacional Monte de Piedad. There are nine stops in this area. Some are buildings that can be seen well from the square, and others have interiors worth exploring. Here, the ground holds another city: the Mexica capital, which lay right beneath.
